prompt:
Use case: illustration-story.
Asset type: one standalone portrait illustration for an Arabic family portrait-recognition game, age 16+.
Primary request: a clearly recognizable faithful portrait of the real public figure Nadine Labaki. Identity accuracy is essential; do not substitute a generic lookalike.
Subject details: Lebanese director and actress Nadine Labaki in her recognizable mature appearance, long wavy dark brown hair, expressive dark almond-shaped eyes, arched brows, oval face and warm reserved smile, simple dark blouse.
Style: polished realistic hand-painted editorial portrait, very subtle visible painted texture, natural human facial proportions, authentic familiar appearance; this is an illustration, not a documentary photograph.
Composition: square 1:1 head and upper shoulders portrait facing the viewer, face centered occupying 65% of height, complete hair and head inside frame with margin. Clear even soft lighting, muted warm grey studio backdrop. Only this one person.
Constraints: no written name, no lettering, captions, logos, signature, watermark, frame, collage, other people, or added symbolic props. Do not exaggerate or caricature the face.

review.sourceReview: Publisher-labeled primary reference and generated portrait actually viewed; visible-trait comparison recorded.
review.fullImage: Cannes names the filmmaker. Both views show long dark hair, arched brows, dark eyes and an oval face; the illustration has a warmer smile.
review.limits: The source includes the torso and the face is smaller than the generated close portrait.
review.revealGameplay: All12 opaque tiles initially closed; each ordinary click opens one; no early answer metadata or enlargement; show/hide answer and new question reset checked in Chrome.
